en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a single cargo or coastal ship at sea, viewed in profile from the starboard side. The vessel has two masts and a superstructure toward the stern, with a small national flag flying at the aft mast. The name "GERTRUD" is painted on the bow. The sea is calm and a low shoreline with some trees and buildings is faintly visible in the background under an overcast sky.
